# Warlock Create Warlock

> Package: `create-warlock`

> Project scaffolder for the Warlock.js framework — interactive wizard and non-interactive CLI for creating new apps.

## Skills

- [create-warlock](create-warlock/skills/SKILL.md): Scaffold Warlock apps with `npm create warlock@latest` or `npx create-warlock`; the CLI entry exports `parseFlags`, `packageVersion` and default `createApp`. Use for "create a project", "start a backend or SSR app", choose a database, AI adapters, features or linting, and automate setup with `--yes` and `--pm=npm`. Not this package → @warlock.js/core for extending an existing app; @warlock.js/web for page APIs.
